result_text:
I changed the warehouse stock list so it no longer shows products with quantity 0. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.

The change is one condition in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`DataStore.java`, line 1491). Its query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, so the list for WH-1 would show only "Bolt 10". `StockService` calls this method, so the service picks up the change.

The single-product quantity lookup is a separate query that I left alone. Asking for nuts in WH-1 should therefore still answer 0.
